spots.notes: turn-01-dry-ace at the online rake (5 percent, 3 bb cap, O-112); informational (O-161).
river-01-dry-ace at the online rake, informational (O-161): S18 reads the rake gap here.

notes: The two raked twins of g4-spots.json (O-161): the same root keys, boards, pots, stacks
and ranges as turn-01-dry-ace and river-01-dry-ace, solved at the online stake's rake
(5 percent capped at 3 bb, O-112) on both sides. Nothing here is gated: the rows are
informational, so S18 learns the rake gap before the builder publishes raked solves.
A list of its own because a node dump holds each key once: a raked twin beside its
rake-free spot in one list would make the compare read the rake-free nodes for both.
Run with just g4-raked ORACLE OUT, which writes the report g4-oracle-raked beside the
gated list's g4-oracle; the oracle dump ORACLE is the private program's run of this list.
Configuration, pair, tree, stop rule and rules are the gated list's; the preflop block
is descriptive (O-164); no number comes from a reference tool (O-26, ADR 0017).
